settings.server.name: Server name
settings.server.scenarioCache.embeddedLi: E.g. :8899. Open it in the firewall separately from the daemon's main port. Requires restarting the daemon.
settings.server.scenarioCache.panelListe: Defaults to the panel's current port. A different value moves distribution to its own port. Requires restarting the panel.
settings.server.scenarioCache.publicUrlB: Must be reachable from outside, not 127.0.0.1/localhost.
settings.server.scenarioCache.statusFail: Scenario cache: fell back to built-in transfer
settings.server.desc.public: Visibility in the server browser (default true)
settings.server.desc.stopPeriod: Auto-stop every, h, 0=off (default 0 — the feature is optional on its own, we don't enable it with an unrequested save)
settings.server.desc.kickPing: Max player ping, ms (default 9999 — deliberately unreachable, the limit is optional and off by default)
settings.server.desc.loginParallel: Parallel logins (default 999 — no real limit, the limit is optional and off by default)
settings.server.desc.vipNames: VIP SteamIDs in the login queue, comma-separated (default empty)
settings.server.desc.gameName: Save folder name. Creates a new save.
settings.server.desc.seed: World generation seed. Creates a new save.
settings.chatbot.serverSenderNameHint: The name scheduler auto-messages (restarts etc.) appear from in the in-game chat, for all players
settings.chatbot.cmdtable.col.name: Name
settings.chatbot.custom.col.name: Name (cb:...)
settings.panel.historyInterval: Min. interval between history points, min
settings.panel.historyMaxEntriesHint: How many most recent inventory history snapshots to keep per player — older ones are deleted automatically
settings.panel.structuresRequireOwnerNea: A snapshot is taken only if the owner (or a faction member, for a faction-owned structure) is physically on the same playfield at the moment of the attempt — otherwise a periodic snapshot could lock in the state left after a raid the owner doesn't know about yet
settings.panel.forceOverwriteInventoryHi: If the player's inventory changed since the edit: on — overwrites silently; off (default) — doesn't apply, sends a notification.
settings.panel.cleanOldBuildLogsHint: Once a day, delete game log folders for every build except the current one (EMP/Logs/<number>) — left behind as dead weight after each game update.
settings.panel.manualActionWarnMinutesHi: Warn players this many minutes ahead. 0 — run without warning.
settings.panel.checkUpdatesPeriodicallyH: Every few hours, anonymously compare the game server build and the active scenario (if installed via Workshop) against the latest Steam versions — a notification appears in the bell if an update is available. No auto-update happens, notification only.
settings.panel.auditUnauthorizedApiReque: Log daemon API requests without a valid token
settings.panel.auditInventoryFuelAnomaly: Log structure fuel above 100% capacity or an item stack above its maximum size
settings.panel.auditWipeLeftoverHint: Log when a player still has personal structures left after resetting their character
settings.panel.auditPositionJumpHint: Log when a player's position moved faster than 100 m/s between polls
settings.panel.auditPermissionFactionCha: Log panel player role changes and structure faction changes
settings.panel.auditLoginTrackingHint: Log successful and failed web panel login attempts
settings.panel.monitoringRetentionDaysHi: How many days to keep saved snapshots — older ones are deleted automatically once a day.
